value.signature: fn validate_marker_history (input : HistoryInput , policy : & ValidatedPolicy , verifier : & impl PublicVerifier ,) -> Result < ValidatedMarkerHistory , BurnError >

review.body: { let result = (| | { if verifier . profile () != policy . input . verification_profile { return Err (BurnError :: Verifier) ; } if input . identity . is_empty () { return Err (BurnError :: HistoryPolicy) ; } let mut positions = BTreeSet :: new () ; if input . markers . iter () . any (| marker | ! positions . insert (marker . history_position)) { return Err (BurnError :: HistoryPosition) ; } let mut names = BTreeSet :: new () ; let mut proofs = BTreeSet :: new () ; for record in & input . records { if record . identity . is_empty () || ! names . insert (record . identity . clone ()) { return Err (BurnError :: RecordIdentity) ; } if ! record . destruction . is_empty () && ! record . address . 0 . is_empty () && ! record . evidence . is_empty () && verifier . destruction (record) { proofs . insert (record . identity . clone ()) ; } } let openings = input . markers . iter () . map (| marker | recover (marker , & policy . input , verifier)) . collect () ; Ok (ValidatedMarkerHistory { input , policy : policy . clone () , verified : proofs , openings , }) }) () ; if result . is_err () { super :: refused () ; } result }
review.item_premise: This body checks public history identity, unique disclosed positions, record identities and verifier profile, retaining verification results and per-candidate openings. Trace records complete public input and typed refusal. The profile is a trusted external boundary; the fixture supplies no chain evidence.
